title: FigAct: Turning Scientific Figures into Active Canvases for Explanation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36190v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Scientific figures are designed to communicate information visually, yet MLLMs typically explain them by translating their visual content back into text. This requires readers to manually map the resulting explanations back to the figure. Inspired by how people present visual information, we introduce FigAct, a framework that transforms static scientific figures into question-conditioned visual presentations by acting directly on their existing graphical elements. Like a human presenter, FigAct generates a sequence of short narrations, grounds each narration in the corresponding visual evidence, and applies visual actions to guide the viewer's attention. We develop a hierarchical search strategy for efficient element localization, reducing token usage by approximately 40$\times$. translated_abstract: 科学图表旨在通过视觉方式传达信息，然而多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）通常通过将图表的视觉内容转译回文本来进行解释，这需要读者手动将生成的解释映射回图表本身。受人们展示视觉信息方式的启发，我们提出了FigAct框架，通过直接作用于图表现有的图形元素，将静态科学图表转化为基于问题条件的视觉演示。如同人类演讲者一样，FigAct生成一系列简短的旁白，将每段旁白定位到相应的视觉证据上，并应用视觉动作来引导观众的注意力。我们开发了一种分层搜索策略以实现高效的元素定位，将token使用量降低约40倍。我们进一步使用针对定位准确性、搜索效率和渲染质量的三个任务特定奖励来训练FigAct-8B模型。此外，我们还构建了一个人工验证的
tldr: 该论文提出FigAct框架，通过直接操作科学图表的图形元素并配以旁白和视觉动作，将静态图表转化为主动式视觉演示，结合分层搜索策略（token用量降低约40倍）和基于三重任务奖励训练的FigAct-8B模型，实现更直观的图表解释。
